maria: Customer reports console shows 'You do not have permission to view this project' and the API returns 403 for alice@acme.com. They were project owners yesterday. Happened after scheduled IdP changes overnight. Any ideas?

raj: Can you paste the exact browser error (network tab) and the org/project IDs? Also are they signing in via SSO or an invite link?

maria: Network payload: {"error":"forbidden","message":"user lacks project:view"}. Org: org_0xabc, Project: proj-42. SSO (SAML) user alice@acme.com. SCIM sync last attempted at 2026-03-15T06:13:02Z.

ops-bot: alert: SCIM sync job failed for acme-corp at 2026-03-15T06:13:02Z - received 502 from idp 

devin: I see the SCIM job errored and our group-mapping cleanup ran afterwards. It looks like inherited roles got cleared when the batch failed. I'll pull sync logs. Meanwhile, can an org admin still see the project? If yes, they can reassign directly.

maria: Org admin bob@acme can see the project and access it. Customer needs Alice back immediately. Any safe workaround?

devin: Temporary workaround: org admin can re-add Alice directly as project owner via Console -> Organization -> Members -> Add member -> Role: Owner. Or use the API (org admin token):
```
POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/orgs/org_0xabc/projects/proj-42/members
Authorization: Bearer <ORG_ADMIN_TOKEN>
Body: {"email":"alice@acme.com","role":"owner"}
```
This bypasses the SCIM mapping until we fully restore memberships.

raj: For root cause we need the SCIM failure details. Devin, can you attach the idp response body and the sync job trace? Tagging infra oncall @elena.

devin: Pulled logs: idp responded 502 Bad Gateway on PATCH /Users/bulk, payload ~1.2MB. Our sync retried twice and then marked batch as failed. After that the cleanup routine interpreted the failed batch as an explicit "members removed" signal and cleared local role cache for affected users. We'll change cleanup to be non-destructive on transient failures.

elena: Oncall here. Opening a P2 incident. I'll run a targeted resync for acme-corp to rehydrate memberships now.

ops-bot: action: /internal/resync-scim org_0xabc triggered by elena at 2026-03-15T08:02:11Z

devin: Resync completed for acme-corp. Confirmed Alice's membership and roles restored in our DB. Please ask customer to sign out and sign back in to refresh tokens.

maria: Confirmed with customer — access restored after sign-out/sign-in. They can see the project again. Thanks all :tada:

raj: Next steps: 1) Patch cleanup logic so it does not delete roles on transient sync failures. 2) Break large batches into smaller chunks + improved backoff to avoid 502s. 3) Post-incident audit and customer notification. I'll file follow-ups and assign owners.

maria: Filing support follow-up and sending the customer a short summary + remediation steps. cc @security for audit trail.

devin: Created ticket INF-7894 for cleanup patch, ETA 48h. Will update thread with progress.

maria: Closing the immediate access issue but keeping incident watch until patch is deployed. :thumbsup:
